input.plan:
# Phase 13 frontend visual redesign

The written KisiEngine direction is the source of truth for this plan. No design image is in the repo, so the palette and layout below follow that written spec rather than an external file.

## What stays unchanged

- Routes in [`apps/web/src/App.tsx`](apps/web/src/App.tsx): `/`, `/workflows/new`, `/workflows/:id`.
- Trigger URL remains the API `triggerUrl` (`https://…/t/:triggerToken`). Copy still writes that full URL. No new workflow model, drag-and-drop, run history, or auth screen.
- List still loads, retries, confirms delete, and toggles enabled with the existing client calls. Editor still creates with POST and saves with PUT. Validation and `role="alert"` messages stay.
- Monaco stays the JSON steps editor (`language="json"`, `ariaLabel: "Workflow steps"`, same options). Theme becomes `vs-dark` only.
- Do not touch API, shared schemas, Prisma, CI, or [`apps/web/vite.config.ts`](apps/web/vite.config.ts).

## Current frontend

- Styling is one global stylesheet, [`apps/web/src/styles.css`](apps/web/src/styles.css): light `#f5f6f8` page, system font, a simple list, no design system.
- [`apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowList.tsx`](apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowList.tsx) is a `<ul>` of name, Enabled/Disabled text, and Edit / Enable / Delete controls. It does not show `triggerUrl`, even though `listWorkflows()` already returns it.
- [`apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowEditor.tsx`](apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowEditor.tsx) is a plain form: name, checkbox, Monaco, then trigger URL after save.
- [`apps/web/src/components/JsonEditor.tsx`](apps/web/src/components/JsonEditor.tsx) uses the default light Monaco theme.

## Files to change

- [`apps/web/src/styles.css`](apps/web/src/styles.css) — dark shell, cards, table, pills, buttons, focus states.
- [`apps/web/src/App.tsx`](apps/web/src/App.tsx) — wrap both the missing-credential screen and the router in one shell so every screen shares the header.
- New [`apps/web/src/components/AppShell.tsx`](apps/web/src/components/AppShell.tsx) — top bar only: wordmark “KisiEngine” linking to `/`, and a Workflows nav link. Pages keep their own `<main>`.
- [`apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowList.tsx`](apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowList.tsx) — table presentation of existing rows, plus copy of the existing `triggerUrl`.
- [`apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowEditor.tsx`](apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowEditor.tsx) — section layout only. Same state and submit path.
- [`apps/web/src/components/JsonEditor.tsx`](apps/web/src/components/JsonEditor.tsx) — `theme="vs-dark"`.
- [`apps/web/index.html`](apps/web/index.html) — document title `KisiEngine`.
- [`apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowList.test.tsx`](apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowList.test.tsx) and [`apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowEditor.test.tsx`](apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowEditor.test.tsx) — only if a visible label’s accessible name changes. No e2e edits expected.

## Visual system

Near-black navy page (`#070b14`), slightly lifted header and cards (`#101624`), 1px borders (`#243049`), 12px card radius, pill radius for URLs and status. Primary actions `#3b82f6` with a darker hover. Focus ring `#93c5fd`. Muted text `#93a0b8`, primary text `#e8eefc`. Enabled status uses a green dot; disabled uses a muted dot. Alerts stay high-contrast (`role="alert"`). No new font or icon package; system UI font and inline SVGs.

## Dashboard

Keep the page heading “Workflows”, add one short description, and style the existing create link as a blue button. Replace the `<ul>` with a dark rounded table: Name, Status, Trigger URL, Actions.

- Status stays the current enable/disable control: visible text `Enabled` / `Disabled`, accessible name `Disable {name}` / `Enable {name}`, same `setWorkflowEnabled` call.
- Trigger URL is a truncated pill of `workflow.triggerUrl`. Copy uses `navigator.clipboard.writeText` and reports failure in an alert. Accessible name `Copy trigger URL for {name}` so it does not collide with the editor Copy button.
- Edit and Delete become icon buttons. Keep `aria-label` `Edit {name}` and `Delete {name}`, and the same confirm string.
- Empty, loading, and retry states stay, restyled inside the card.
- Narrow viewports stack each row into a card; the table remains one region on wide screens.

## Editor

Same fields, reordered to match the reference:

- Header shell, then title `Create workflow` or `Edit workflow`.
- Name field, then the existing Enabled checkbox restyled as a switch. It stays `role="checkbox"` named `Enabled`.
- HTTP Trigger card: a `POST` badge and the current read-only Trigger URL textbox. Before save, keep the exact sentence `The trigger URL is assigned when you save.` Copy stays a button named `Copy`.
- Steps heading, then Monaco inside a dark rounded frame. Validation alerts stay directly under the editor.
- Submit button reads `Save Workflow` while idle and `Saving...` while the request is in flight. Disabled rules do not change.

## Tests

These queries must keep working. Playwright matches names as case-insensitive substrings, so e2e [`e2e/workflow-trigger.spec.ts`](e2e/workflow-trigger.spec.ts) still finds `Create workflow`, `Name`, `Enabled`, `Workflow steps`, `Save`, and `Trigger URL` if the idle submit label becomes `Save Workflow`.

Unit tests use exact names, so update only:

- list: link name `Create workflow` if the visible label becomes `Create Workflow`
- editor: button name `Save` to `Save Workflow` in the idle-state assertions

Leave `Saving...`, `Enabled` / `Disabled`, `Edit {name}`, `Delete {name}`, `Disable {name}`, `Trigger URL`, `Copy`, `Workflow steps`, loading and empty copy, and `Back to workflows` exactly as they are. Do not change [`apps/web/src/App.test.tsx`](apps/web/src/App.test.tsx), [`apps/web/src/validation.test.ts`](apps/web/src/validation.test.ts), or [`apps/web/src/api/client.test.ts`](apps/web/src/api/client.test.ts).

## Check

Run `npm test` in `apps/web`. Then open the list and editor and confirm create, edit, enable/disable, copy, delete, invalid JSON, and the missing-credential screen still behave as they do now.

input.plan:
# Phase 13.1 toast notifications

A local React context, with no new dependency. Toast state lives above the routes so a create success notice survives navigation from `/workflows/new` to `/workflows/:id`, which remounts [`WorkflowEditor`](apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowEditor.tsx).

## Mechanism

New [`apps/web/src/components/toast.tsx`](apps/web/src/components/toast.tsx):

- `ToastProvider` holds a list of `{ id, message, variant }`.
- `useToast()` returns `showToast(message, variant)` and throws if used outside the provider.
- The viewport is `position: fixed; right: 24px; bottom: 24px`, a column with a gap so toasts stack and do not overlap. The viewport uses `pointer-events: none`; each toast uses `pointer-events: auto`, so the page stays usable.
- Each toast is `role="status"` for success and `role="alert"` for error, inside a region labeled `Notifications`. A dismiss button removes one toast. A 3 second timeout removes it automatically and is cleared on dismiss or unmount.
- Styles go in [`apps/web/src/styles.css`](apps/web/src/styles.css): dark card (`#101624`), border `#243049`, success accent `#34d399`, error accent `#f87171`. Toast color rules are more specific than the existing `[role="alert"]` rule so error toasts stay styled and validation alerts are unchanged.

Wire `ToastProvider` in [`apps/web/src/App.tsx`](apps/web/src/App.tsx) inside `BrowserRouter`, around `AppShell`, so both pages share it. Routes stay the same.

## Action integration

Call `showToast` only after the existing request or clipboard call settles. Do not toast when client validation blocks save. Keep `window.confirm` for delete.

[`apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowEditor.tsx`](apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowEditor.tsx):

- After `createWorkflow` succeeds, toast `Workflow created successfully`, then navigate as today.
- After `replaceWorkflow` succeeds, toast `Workflow updated successfully`.
- In the existing save `catch`, keep `setSaveError(formatApiError(error))` and also toast `Failed to save workflow`. Inline text such as `name: too long` stays.
- Name and steps `role="alert"` validation messages stay. Invalid JSON still does not submit and does not toast.
- Copy success toasts `Trigger URL copied`. Copy failure toasts `Failed to copy trigger URL` and the inline copy alert is removed.

[`apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowList.tsx`](apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowList.tsx):

- Delete success: `Workflow deleted successfully`. Delete failure: `Failed to delete workflow`.
- Toggle success uses the updated workflow: `Workflow enabled` or `Workflow disabled`. Failure: `Failed to update workflow`.
- Copy success and failure use the same two copy messages as the editor.
- List load failure, the Retry button, and the empty state stay on the inline alert. Delete, toggle, and copy stop writing into that load error, so a failed action does not show Retry.

## Tests

Wrap the helpers in [`apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowList.test.tsx`](apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowList.test.tsx) and [`apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowEditor.test.tsx`](apps/web/src/pages/WorkflowEditor.test.tsx) with `ToastProvider` inside `MemoryRouter`. Existing assertions stay.

Add cases:

- List: delete success and rejected delete; enable and disable success; rejected toggle; clipboard resolve and reject.
- Editor: create shows `Workflow created successfully` after the trigger URL appears; replace shows `Workflow updated successfully`; rejected save still shows `name: too long` and also `Failed to save workflow`; copy success and clipboard rejection. The invalid-steps tests still show only the inline validation alert.

New [`apps/web/src/components/toast.test.tsx`](apps/web/src/components/toast.test.tsx) uses fake timers to assert a toast disappears after 3 seconds, two toasts are both visible, and dismiss removes only the chosen one. Page tests do not use fake timers, so they do not fight `userEvent`.
